sol_message: raj.sol is a .sol name. SNS moved its names to .sns in August 2026 and ".sol" now belongs to the Solana Record Service, which isn't live yet; SNS's own resolver stopped resolving .sol at Solana slot 452,825,395 (October 2026). Owed won't guess who a .sol name pays. If the user means the SNS name, ask again with raj.sns, and check with them that it is theirs.
